draft.text: You came in because you hurt your knee while skiing.
You said your knee popped when you fell and now it hurts and feels unstable.
You said your knee has been swollen and painful since the injury.
The pain is on the outside of your knee and gets worse when you try to straighten your leg.
You may have injured your knee ligaments or other structures.
An X-ray did not show any broken bones, but you have not had an MRI yet.
You will follow up with your doctor after the MRI results are available.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you hurt your knee while skiing.
You said your knee popped when you fell.
Your knee is swollen and painful, especially on the outside.
You have trouble straightening your leg.
You may have injured your knee ligaments.
This can happen when the knee bends awkwardly.
The doctor will order an MRI to check for damage.
You will come back when the results are ready.
